title: Preserve explicit FOLLOW while transcript Find remains open
outcome: Scroll review through commit 856d5df. Leave a nonempty Find query open, explicitly return to the bottom with Send, End or New response, then allow transcript content to change. SessionPaneView.scroll.ts:3069-3084 unconditionally calls setTailFollowIntent(false) whenever hasSessionFindQuery is true and the content transition is not residentHistoryOnly. This cancels user-selected FOLLOW, even if the query has zero matches. Earlier temporary hook probe used a no-match query: explicit bottom navigation reached 800 and FOLLOW=true, then an assistant append changed FOLLOW=false and showed the indicator without new reader input. Probe removed; latest code-only review confirms the branch remains. This is a remaining gap in the Send fix tracked by tm-7cu.34. Distinct from search-match object replay: this reproduces with no match and no search scrollIntoView. Content changes must not override explicit follow state under the September 3 specification.
acceptance: After accepted Send, End, reaching bottom or clicking New response, FOLLOW persists on subsequent transcript growth even if Find remains open, including a query with no matches. An explicit later search navigation or upward reader gesture can select STAY; ordinary content changes cannot. Retain STAY behavior for approvals/user-input activity. Add regressions for the real Send integration and bottom-navigation/content-update path; demonstrate failure before the fix. TypeScript and affected suites pass.
